data.title: bn-102d: run runtime-role tool smokes uncontrolled
data.description: evaluator/terminal_verifier tool smokes ran controlled=True but their Python --smoke handlers only emit a JSON line and never speak the control handshake, so run_child's boot read hit EOF -> 'control socket closed before boot' (deterministic; evaluator row exit_status=0 but interrupted=RunnerFailure..., terminal_verifier never ran). Fix: ChildPlan gains controlled flag (default True); the two runtime-role smokes set controlled=False; _run_contract_smoke honors plan.controlled. evaluate.py binding_transition parameterized to emit controlled=False for RUNNER_SMOKE_RUNTIME_ROLES + self-test fixture updated, because the evaluator requires CONTROL_FD iff controlled (evidence_schema.transition_child_environment 2053-2064). Measured/correctness/fault keep controlled=True. Diagnosed via Fable subagent, verified vs rehearsal-v11-r1/r2 evidence. Self-tests: runner 163/163, evaluator 311/311, verifier 187/187, semantic-authority PASS. Commit 4e0d2a2.
